source.text: וַיְהִ֣י אַֽחֲרֵי־כֵ֗ן וַיִּשְׁאַל֩ דָּוִ֨ד בַּֽיהוָ֤ה׀לֵאמֹר֙ הַאֶעֱלֶ֗ה בְּאַחַת֙ עָרֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֔ה וַיֹּ֧אמֶר יְהוָ֛ה אֵלָ֖יו עֲלֵ֑ה וַיֹּ֧אמֶר דָּוִ֛ד אָ֥נָה אֶעֱלֶ֖ה וַיֹּ֥אמֶר חֶבְרֹֽנָה׃

records.literal_gloss: And it was after thus, and asked David of Yahweh, saying, Shall I go up into one of [the] cities of Judah? And said Yahweh to him, Go up. And said David, Where shall I go up? And he said, To Hebron.

en.L: And it was after this [that] David inquired of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, saying, "Shall I go up into one of the cities of Judah?" And {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} said to him, "Go up." And David said, "Where shall I go up?" And {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} said, "To Hebron."
en.B: Some time after this, David inquired of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}: "Shall I go up into any of the towns of Judah?" {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} told him, "Go up." David asked, "Where should I go?" And {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} answered, "To Hebron."
en.R: After this, David asked {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, "Should I go up to one of the towns in Judah?" {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} told him, "Go." David asked, "Which town should I go to?" {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} answered, "Hebron."

es.L: Y sucedió después de esto [que] David consultó {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, diciendo: «¿Subiré a alguna de las ciudades de Judá?». Y {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} le dijo: «Sube». Y David dijo: «¿Adónde subiré?». Y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} dijo: «A Hebrón».
es.B: Algún tiempo después, David consultó {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}: «¿Debo subir a alguno de los pueblos de Judá?». {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} le respondió: «Sube». David preguntó: «¿Adónde debo ir?». Y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} contestó: «A Hebrón».
es.R: Después de esto, David le preguntó {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}: «¿Debo ir a alguno de los pueblos de Judá?». {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} le dijo: «Ve». David preguntó: «¿A qué pueblo debo ir?». {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} respondió: «A Hebrón».

fr.L: Et il arriva après cela [que] David consulta {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, en disant : « Monterai-je dans une des villes de Juda ? » Et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} lui dit : « Monte. » Et David dit : « Où monterai-je ? » Et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} dit : « À Hébron. »
fr.B: Quelque temps après, David consulta {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} : « Dois-je monter dans l’une des villes de Juda ? » {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} lui répondit : « Monte. » David demanda : « Où dois-je aller ? » Et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} répondit : « À Hébron. »
fr.R: Après cela, David a demandé {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} : « Est-ce que je dois aller dans une des villes de Juda ? » {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} lui a dit : « Vas-y. » David a demandé : « Dans quelle ville dois-je aller ? » {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a répondu : « À Hébron. »

sw.L: Ikawa baada ya hayo Daudi akamwuliza {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, akisema, "Je, nipande kwenda katika mmojawapo wa miji ya Yuda?" {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akamwambia, "Panda." Daudi akasema, "Nipande kwenda wapi?" Akasema, "Hebroni."
sw.B: Baada ya hayo, Daudi alimwuliza {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, "Je, nipande kwenda katika mji wowote wa Yuda?" {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akamwambia, "Panda." Daudi akauliza, "Niende wapi?" Akajibu, "Hebroni."
sw.R: Baada ya hayo, Daudi alimwuliza {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, "Je, niende katika mmoja wa miji ya Yuda?" {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akamwambia, "Nenda." Daudi akauliza, "Niende mji gani?" {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akajibu, "Hebroni."

vi.L: Sau việc này, Đa-vít cầu hỏi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} rằng: "Con có nên đi lên một trong các thành của Giu-đa không?" {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán với ông: "Hãy đi lên." Đa-vít thưa: "Con phải đi lên đâu?" {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} phán: "Đến Hếp-rôn."
vi.B: Sau đó ít lâu, Đa-vít cầu hỏi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}: "Con có nên đi lên một thành nào của Giu-đa không?" {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán với ông: "Hãy đi lên." Đa-vít thưa: "Con nên đi đến đâu?" {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đáp: "Đến Hếp-rôn."
vi.R: Sau đó, Đa-vít cầu hỏi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}: "Con có nên đi lên một thành nào ở Giu-đa không?" {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán với ông: "Hãy đi." Đa-vít hỏi: "Con nên đến thành nào?" {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đáp: "Hếp-rôn."

ko.L: 그 뒤에 다윗이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 여쭈어 말했다. "제가 유다의 성읍들 가운데 하나로 올라가야 합니까?" 그러자 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그에게 "올라가거라" 하고 말씀하셨다. 그리고 다윗이 "어디로 올라가야 합니까?" 하고 말하자, 그분께서 "헤브론으로" 하고 말씀하셨다.
ko.B: 얼마 뒤에 다윗이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 여쭈었다. "제가 유다의 성읍들 가운데 한 곳으로 올라가도 되겠습니까?" {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그에게 "올라가거라" 하고 말씀하셨다. 다윗이 "어디로 가야 합니까?" 하고 여쭈니, 그분께서 "헤브론으로 가거라" 하고 대답하셨다.
ko.R: 그 뒤에 다윗이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 여쭈었다. "제가 유다에 있는 성읍 가운데 한 곳으로 올라갈까요?" {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 "가거라" 하고 말씀하셨다. 다윗이 "어느 성읍으로 가야 합니까?" 하고 여쭈었다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 "헤브론이다" 하고 대답하셨다.

pt.L: E aconteceu depois disso [que] Davi consultou {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, dizendo: "Subirei a uma das cidades de Judá?" E {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} lhe disse: "Sobe." E Davi disse: "Para onde subirei?" E {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} disse: "Para Hebrom."
pt.B: Algum tempo depois, Davi consultou {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}: "Devo subir a alguma das cidades de Judá?" {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} lhe respondeu: "Sobe." Davi perguntou: "Para onde devo ir?" E {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} respondeu: "Para Hebrom."
pt.R: Depois disso, Davi perguntou {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}: "Devo subir para uma das cidades de Judá?" {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} lhe respondeu: "Vai." Davi perguntou: "Para qual cidade devo ir?" {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} respondeu: "Hebrom."

decisions.choice: inquired of the LORD: asked God for guidance, probably through the priest and the ephod
decisions.reason: David had asked the LORD in this way before, when the priest Abiathar brought him the ephod (1 Samuel 23:2, 4, 9-12; 30:7-8). The short yes-or-no question and the one-word answer fit that kind of asking.

decisions.choice: after this: after the news of Saul's death and David's lament for Saul and Jonathan
decisions.reason: The words join this chapter to chapter 1. With Saul dead, David now asks where he should go.

decisions.choice: Hebron: an old city in the hill country of Judah
decisions.reason: Hebron was where Abraham bought a burial place for his family (Genesis 23:2, 19), and it had been given to Caleb of Judah (Joshua 14:13-14). David had sent gifts to its leaders (1 Samuel 30:31). It stands high in the hills, so from the south one "goes up" to it.

decisions.choice: towns
decisions.reason: The word is usually "city", but the places of Judah were small walled settlements, so Balanced and Readable say "towns".

decisions.choice: The LORD answered
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says only "he said". Readable names the speaker so a young reader does not lose track.

decisions.choice: consulter le SEIGNEUR (L, B); demander au SEIGNEUR (R)
decisions.reason: As the Samuel terms note sets, "inquire of the LORD" is "consulter le SEIGNEUR"; Readable uses the everyday verb "demander", as the English Readable says "asked".

decisions.choice: "consultar al SEÑOR" (L, B); "preguntarle al SEÑOR" (R)
decisions.reason: As the Samuel terms note sets for inquiring of the LORD; Readable uses the plainer verb, as the English "asked".

decisions.choice: kumwuliza BWANA
decisions.reason: "Inquire of the LORD" is "kumwuliza BWANA" at every level, as set for Samuel in Swahili. The English "he|He" span falls on a pronoun that Swahili carries in the verb ("akasema"), so there is no deity pronoun span here.

decisions.choice: "cầu hỏi CHÚA"
decisions.reason: The Samuel terms note's phrase for asking God's guidance (meaning decision); David prays as "con" and God answers with "phán", as the Genesis note sets.

decisions.choice: "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 여쭈다" for inquiring of the LORD; David speaks to God in the formal polite style (합쇼체) and God answers in the plain style (해라체)
decisions.reason: As the Samuel terms note: the humble verb "여쭈다" shows David asking God for guidance. Korean has no capital letters, so the English deity_pronoun span has no Korean counterpart; "그분께서" and the honorific carry the respect.

decisions.choice: "성읍" for the towns (*ʿarim*) of Judah
decisions.reason: "성읍" is the usual Bible word for a walled town; it is kept at every level here and in the book, and Readable uses it too because the story often turns on a town's walls and gate.

decisions.choice: consultou o SENHOR; Sobe, Vai (tu)
decisions.reason: David inquires of the LORD as in 1 Samuel 23:2 and 4 in Portuguese (m1), and the LORD answers him with the "tu" imperative "Sobe" ("Vai" at Readable), as God speaks to one person throughout the Portuguese Old Testament. Balanced and Readable say "cidades": Portuguese "cidade" is used for small walled towns as well, so the English change to "towns" is not needed.

source.text: וַיַּ֤עַל שָׁם֙ דָּוִ֔ד וְגַ֖ם שְׁתֵּ֣י נָשָׁ֑יו אֲחִינֹ֨עַם֙ הַיִּזְרְעֵלִ֔ית וַאֲבִיגַ֕יִל אֵ֖שֶׁת נָבָ֥ל הַֽכַּרְמְלִֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: And went up there David, and also [the] two of his wives, Ahinoam the Jezreelite and Abigail [the] wife of Nabal the Carmelite.

en.L: So David went up there, and also his two wives, Ahinoam the Jezreelite and Abigail the wife of Nabal the Carmelite.
en.B: So David went up there, and his two wives went with him: Ahinoam of Jezreel, and Abigail, who had been the wife of Nabal of Carmel.
en.R: So David went to Hebron. His two wives went with him. One was Ahinoam from Jezreel. The other was Abigail, whose husband Nabal from Carmel had died.

es.L: Y subió allá David, y también sus dos mujeres, Ahinoam la jezreelita y Abigail, la mujer de Nabal el carmelita.
es.B: Así que David subió allá, y sus dos esposas fueron con él: Ahinoam de Jezreel y Abigail, que había sido esposa de Nabal de Carmel.
es.R: Así que David fue a Hebrón. Sus dos esposas fueron con él. Una era Ahinoam, de Jezreel. La otra era Abigail, cuyo esposo Nabal, de Carmel, había muerto.

fr.L: Et David monta là, et aussi ses deux femmes, Ahinoam la Jizreélite et Abigaïl, la femme de Nabal le Carmélite.
fr.B: David monta donc là-bas, et ses deux femmes l’accompagnèrent : Ahinoam de Jizreël, et Abigaïl, qui avait été la femme de Nabal de Carmel.
fr.R: David est donc allé à Hébron. Ses deux femmes sont allées avec lui. L’une était Ahinoam, de Jizreël. L’autre était Abigaïl, dont le mari, Nabal de Carmel, était mort.

sw.L: Basi Daudi akapanda huko, na pia wake zake wawili, Ahinoamu Myezreeli na Abigaili mke wa Nabali Mkarmeli.
sw.B: Basi Daudi alipanda huko, na wake zake wawili wakaenda pamoja naye: Ahinoamu wa Yezreeli, na Abigaili, aliyekuwa mke wa Nabali wa Karmeli.
sw.R: Basi Daudi akaenda Hebroni. Wake zake wawili walikwenda pamoja naye. Mmoja alikuwa Ahinoamu wa Yezreeli. Mwingine alikuwa Abigaili, ambaye mumewe Nabali wa Karmeli alikuwa amekufa.

vi.L: Vậy Đa-vít đi lên đó, cùng với hai người vợ của ông là A-hi-nô-am người Gít-rê-ên và A-bi-ga-in vợ của Na-banh người Cạt-mên.
vi.B: Vậy Đa-vít đi lên đó, có hai người vợ của ông đi theo: A-hi-nô-am người Gít-rê-ên và A-bi-ga-in, trước kia là vợ của Na-banh người Cạt-mên.
vi.R: Vậy Đa-vít đi đến Hếp-rôn. Hai người vợ của ông cũng đi theo. Một người là A-hi-nô-am, quê ở Gít-rê-ên. Người kia là A-bi-ga-in, vợ góa của Na-banh người Cạt-mên.

ko.L: 그래서 다윗이 그리로 올라갔고, 그의 두 아내, 이스르엘 여자 아히노암과 갈멜 사람 나발의 아내 아비가일도 [올라갔다].
ko.B: 그래서 다윗이 그리로 올라갔다. 그의 두 아내, 곧 이스르엘 출신 아히노암과 갈멜 사람 나발의 아내였던 아비가일도 그와 함께 갔다.
ko.R: 그래서 다윗은 헤브론으로 갔다. 그의 두 아내도 함께 갔다. 한 사람은 이스르엘에서 온 아히노암이었고, 또 한 사람은 아비가일이었다. 아비가일의 남편이었던 갈멜 사람 나발은 이미 죽었다.

pt.L: E Davi subiu para lá, e também as suas duas mulheres, Ainoã, a jezreelita, e Abigail, mulher de Nabal, o carmelita.
pt.B: Então Davi subiu para lá, e as suas duas mulheres foram com ele: Ainoã de Jezreel e Abigail, que tinha sido mulher de Nabal de Carmelo.
pt.R: Então Davi foi para Hebrom. As suas duas mulheres foram com ele. Uma era Ainoã, de Jezreel. A outra era Abigail, cujo marido, Nabal, de Carmelo, tinha morrido.

decisions.choice: Ahinoam and Abigail: the two wives David had married while he was in hiding
decisions.reason: David married both women after Nabal's death (1 Samuel 25:39-43), and they had lived with him among the Philistines and at Ziklag (1 Samuel 27:3; 30:5, 18).

decisions.choice: Jezreel and Carmel: towns in the hills of Judah
decisions.reason: This Jezreel is a town of Judah (Joshua 15:56), not the northern valley named in verse 9. Carmel is a town south of Hebron (Joshua 15:55; 1 Samuel 25:2), not Mount Carmel on the coast.

decisions.choice: wife of Nabal: Nabal's widow
decisions.reason: Nabal had died (1 Samuel 25:37-38). She is still named by her first husband, as people were then known by their family ties.

decisions.choice: who had been the wife of (Balanced); whose husband ... had died (Readable)
decisions.reason: "The wife of Nabal" could make a reader think Nabal was still alive. Balanced and Readable say what the phrase means here.

decisions.choice: to Hebron
decisions.reason: Readable names the place "there" points to (verse 1).

decisions.choice: "Gít-rê-ên", "Cạt-mên"
decisions.reason: Names not in the terms note's table, given the usual Protestant forms and kept through the book.

source.text: וַאֲנָשָׁ֧יו אֲשֶׁר־עִמּ֛וֹ הֶעֱלָ֥ה דָוִ֖ד אִ֣ישׁ וּבֵית֑וֹ וַיֵּשְׁב֖וּ בְּעָרֵ֥י חֶבְרֽוֹן׃

records.literal_gloss: And his men who [were] with him brought up David, each and his household, and they dwelt in [the] cities of Hebron.

en.L: And his men who [were] with him David brought up, each man and his household, and they lived in the cities of Hebron.
en.B: David also brought up his men, every one of them with his household, and they made their homes in the towns around Hebron.
en.R: David also took along the men who had been with him, and each man brought his family. They made their homes in the towns near Hebron.

es.L: Y a sus hombres que [estaban] con él los hizo subir David, cada uno con su casa, y habitaron en las ciudades de Hebrón.
es.B: David también hizo subir a sus hombres, cada uno con su familia, y se establecieron en los pueblos alrededor de Hebrón.
es.R: David también llevó consigo a los hombres que habían estado con él, y cada uno llevó a su familia. Se establecieron en los pueblos cercanos a Hebrón.

fr.L: Et ses hommes qui [étaient] avec lui, David les fit monter, chacun avec sa maison, et ils habitèrent dans les villes d’Hébron.
fr.B: David fit aussi monter ses hommes, chacun avec sa famille, et ils s’installèrent dans les villes des environs d’Hébron.
fr.R: David a aussi emmené les hommes qui étaient avec lui, et chacun a amené sa famille. Ils se sont installés dans les villes près d’Hébron.

sw.L: Na watu wake waliokuwa pamoja naye Daudi akawapandisha, kila mtu na nyumba yake, nao wakakaa katika miji ya Hebroni.
sw.B: Daudi aliwapandisha pia watu wake, kila mmoja pamoja na jamaa yake, nao wakafanya makao yao katika miji iliyozunguka Hebroni.
sw.R: Daudi aliwachukua pia watu waliokuwa pamoja naye, na kila mmoja akaleta jamaa yake. Wakajenga makao yao katika miji iliyo karibu na Hebroni.

vi.L: Còn những người theo ông, Đa-vít cũng đem họ lên, mỗi người cùng với gia đình mình, và họ sống trong các thành của Hếp-rôn.
vi.B: Đa-vít cũng đem theo những người đi với ông, mỗi người cùng gia đình mình, và họ định cư trong các thành quanh Hếp-rôn.
vi.R: Đa-vít cũng đưa những người theo ông đi cùng, mỗi người dẫn theo gia đình mình. Họ ở trong các thị trấn gần Hếp-rôn.

ko.L: 그리고 다윗이 자기와 함께 [있던] 부하들을, 각 사람과 그의 집안을 데리고 올라갔고, 그들이 헤브론의 성읍들에서 살았다.
ko.B: 다윗은 자기 부하들도 각자 가족과 함께 데리고 올라갔다. 그들은 헤브론 주변의 성읍들에 자리 잡고 살았다.
ko.R: 다윗은 자기와 함께 있던 부하들도 데리고 갔다. 부하들은 저마다 가족을 데려왔다. 그들은 헤브론 근처의 성읍들에서 살았다.

pt.L: E os seus homens que [estavam] com ele Davi fez subir, cada um com a sua casa, e habitaram nas cidades de Hebrom.
pt.B: Davi também levou os seus homens, cada um com a sua família, e eles se estabeleceram nas cidades em volta de Hebrom.
pt.R: Davi também levou os homens que tinham estado com ele, e cada um levou a sua família. Eles foram morar nas cidades perto de Hebrom.

decisions.choice: his men: the band that had followed David while Saul hunted him
decisions.reason: About six hundred men had gathered to David, and they had lived with their families at Ziklag (1 Samuel 22:2; 27:2-3; 30:3).

decisions.choice: cities of Hebron: the towns and villages that belonged to Hebron
decisions.reason: Hebron itself could not hold so many families. The phrase means the settlements in its district, as towns are said to have their "villages" (Joshua 15:54).

decisions.choice: household: a man's wife, children and others who lived under his care
decisions.reason: The word "house" covers everyone in a man's family home, not only the building.

decisions.choice: the towns around Hebron; the towns near Hebron
decisions.reason: "Cities of Hebron" would suggest Hebron was several cities. Balanced and Readable say how the towns were related to it.

source.text: וַיָּבֹ֨אוּ֙ אַנְשֵׁ֣י יְהוּדָ֔ה וַיִּמְשְׁחוּ־שָׁ֧ם אֶת־דָּוִ֛ד לְמֶ֖לֶךְ עַל־בֵּ֣ית יְהוּדָ֑ה וַיַּגִּ֤דוּ לְדָוִד֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר אַנְשֵׁי֙ יָבֵ֣ישׁ גִּלְעָ֔ד אֲשֶׁ֥ר קָבְר֖וּ אֶת־שָׁאֽוּל׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And came [the] men of Judah and anointed there David as king over [the] house of Judah. And they told David, saying, [The] men of Jabesh-gilead [are those] who buried Saul.

en.L: And the men of Judah came, and they anointed David there as king over the house of Judah. And they told David, saying, "[It was] the men of Jabesh-gilead who buried Saul."
en.B: Then the men of Judah came and anointed David there as king over the house of Judah. David was told, "The men of Jabesh-gilead were the ones who buried Saul."
en.R: The men of Judah came to Hebron. There they poured oil on David's head and made him king over the people of Judah. Someone told David, "The men of Jabesh-gilead buried Saul."

es.L: Y vinieron los hombres de Judá y ungieron allí a David como rey sobre la casa de Judá. Y le informaron a David, diciendo: «Los hombres de Jabes de Galaad [son los] que sepultaron a Saúl».
es.B: Entonces vinieron los hombres de Judá y allí ungieron a David como rey sobre la casa de Judá. Le dijeron a David: «Los hombres de Jabes de Galaad fueron quienes sepultaron a Saúl».
es.R: Los hombres de Judá llegaron a Hebrón. Allí derramaron aceite sobre la cabeza de David y lo hicieron rey del pueblo de Judá. Alguien le dijo a David: «Los hombres de Jabes de Galaad sepultaron a Saúl».

fr.L: Et les hommes de Juda vinrent, et ils oignirent là David comme roi sur la maison de Juda. Et on informa David, en disant : « [Ce sont] les hommes de Yabesh de Galaad qui ont enseveli Saül. »
fr.B: Puis les hommes de Juda vinrent et oignirent là David comme roi sur la maison de Juda. On rapporta à David : « Ce sont les hommes de Yabesh de Galaad qui ont enseveli Saül. »
fr.R: Les hommes de Juda sont venus à Hébron. Là, ils ont versé de l’huile sur la tête de David et l’ont fait roi sur le peuple de Juda. Quelqu’un a dit à David : « Les hommes de Yabesh de Galaad ont enterré Saül. »

sw.L: Watu wa Yuda wakaja, nao wakampaka Daudi mafuta huko awe mfalme juu ya nyumba ya Yuda. Wakamwambia Daudi, wakisema, "Watu wa Yabeshi ya Gileadi [ndio] waliomzika Sauli."
sw.B: Kisha watu wa Yuda walikuja, wakampaka Daudi mafuta huko awe mfalme juu ya nyumba ya Yuda. Daudi akaambiwa, "Watu wa Yabeshi ya Gileadi ndio waliomzika Sauli."
sw.R: Watu wa Yuda walikuja Hebroni. Huko wakamimina mafuta juu ya kichwa cha Daudi, wakamfanya mfalme juu ya watu wa Yuda. Mtu mmoja akamwambia Daudi, "Watu wa Yabeshi ya Gileadi walimzika Sauli."

vi.L: Người Giu-đa đến và xức dầu cho Đa-vít tại đó làm vua cai trị nhà Giu-đa. Rồi người ta báo cho Đa-vít rằng: "[Chính] người Gia-be ở Ga-la-át đã chôn cất Sau-lơ."
vi.B: Bấy giờ người Giu-đa đến và xức dầu cho Đa-vít tại đó làm vua cai trị nhà Giu-đa. Có người báo cho Đa-vít: "Người Gia-be ở Ga-la-át đã chôn cất Sau-lơ."
vi.R: Người Giu-đa đến Hếp-rôn. Tại đó họ đổ dầu trên đầu Đa-vít và lập ông làm vua cai trị dân Giu-đa. Có người báo cho Đa-vít: "Người Gia-be ở Ga-la-át đã chôn cất Sau-lơ."

ko.L: 그리고 유다 사람들이 와서, 거기에서 다윗에게 기름을 부어 유다 집의 왕으로 세웠다. 그리고 그들이 다윗에게 알려 말했다. "사울을 장사 지낸 이들은 길르앗 야베스 사람들[입니다]."
ko.B: 그때 유다 사람들이 와서 거기에서 다윗에게 기름을 부어 유다 집안의 왕으로 세웠다. 누군가 다윗에게 "길르앗 야베스 사람들이 사울을 장사 지냈습니다" 하고 알려 주었다.
ko.R: 유다 사람들이 헤브론으로 왔다. 그들은 거기에서 다윗의 머리에 기름을 부어 그를 유다 백성의 왕으로 세웠다. 누군가 다윗에게 말했다. "길르앗 야베스 사람들이 사울을 묻어 주었습니다."

pt.L: E os homens de Judá vieram e ungiram ali Davi como rei sobre a casa de Judá. E informaram Davi, dizendo: "Os homens de Jabes-Gileade [são os] que sepultaram Saul."
pt.B: Então os homens de Judá vieram e ali ungiram Davi como rei sobre a casa de Judá. Contaram a Davi: "Foram os homens de Jabes-Gileade que sepultaram Saul."
pt.R: Os homens de Judá vieram a Hebrom. Ali derramaram azeite na cabeça de Davi e o fizeram rei sobre o povo de Judá. Alguém contou a Davi: "Os homens de Jabes-Gileade sepultaram Saul."

decisions.choice: anointed David as king: poured oil on him to set him apart as king
decisions.reason: Samuel had anointed David privately years before (1 Samuel 16:13). Now his own tribe anoints him in public. All Israel will anoint him later (5:3).

decisions.choice: the house of Judah: the tribe of Judah as one people
decisions.reason: "House" here means a family line grown into a tribe. David's kingdom at this point is Judah alone (verse 10).

decisions.choice: the men of Jabesh-gilead buried Saul
decisions.reason: After the Philistines hung the bodies of Saul and his sons on the wall of Beth-shan, the men of Jabesh-gilead took them down by night and buried them (1 Samuel 31:11-13). Saul had once saved their town (1 Samuel 11:1-11).

decisions.choice: they told David: someone brought David word
decisions.reason: The verb has no named subject; it simply means David was told.

decisions.choice: David was told (Balanced); Someone told David (Readable)
decisions.reason: English needs either a passive or an unnamed "someone" for the Hebrew's unnamed "they". Readable also says "the people of Judah" for "the house of Judah".

decisions.choice: poured oil on David's head and made him king
decisions.reason: Readable explains what anointing was (see m1), as in Psalm 133:2 and 1 Samuel 10:1, where oil is poured on the head.

decisions.choice: on informa David (L); on rapporta à David (B); quelqu'un a dit à David (R)
decisions.reason: French says the Hebrew's unnamed "they" naturally with "on" (m4), so Literal and Balanced need no passive; Readable follows the English "someone".

decisions.choice: "le informaron" (L); "le dijeron" (B); "alguien le dijo" (R)
decisions.reason: Spanish can keep the Hebrew's unnamed "they" with a plural verb, which needs neither a passive nor a named subject; Readable follows the English "someone".

decisions.choice: wakampaka mafuta (Literal, Balanced); wakamimina mafuta juu ya kichwa (Readable)
decisions.reason: "Anoint" is "kumpaka mafuta", as set for Samuel in Swahili; Readable says how it was done, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "기름을 부어 왕으로 세우다" for anointing a king
decisions.reason: As the Samuel terms note sets for anointing; "세우다" says plainly that the anointing made him king.

source.text: וַיִּשְׁלַ֤ח דָּוִד֙ מַלְאָכִ֔ים אֶל־אַנְשֵׁ֖י יָבֵ֣ישׁ גִּלְעָ֑ד וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֲלֵיהֶ֗ם בְּרֻכִ֤ים אַתֶּם֙ לַֽיהוָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר עֲשִׂיתֶ֜ם הַחֶ֣סֶד הַזֶּ֗ה עִם־אֲדֹֽנֵיכֶם֙ עִם־שָׁא֔וּל וַֽתִּקְבְּר֖וּ אֹתֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: And sent David messengers to [the] men of Jabesh-gilead and said to them, Blessed [are] you to Yahweh, who did this steadfast love with your lord, with Saul, and buried him.

en.L: And David sent messengers to the men of Jabesh-gilead and said to them, "Blessed [are] you by {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, you who have done this steadfast love with your lord, with Saul, and have buried him.
en.B: David sent messengers to the men of Jabesh-gilead to say to them, "May {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} bless you, because you showed this faithful love to your lord Saul by burying him.
en.R: David sent messengers to the men of Jabesh-gilead with this message: "May {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} bless you! You showed faithful love to Saul, your master, when you buried him.

es.L: Y envió David mensajeros a los hombres de Jabes de Galaad y les dijo: «Benditos {{plural_you:sean|seáis}} {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, que {{plural_you:hicieron|hicisteis}} este amor leal con {{plural_you:su|vuestro}} señor, con Saúl, y lo {{plural_you:sepultaron|sepultasteis}}.
es.B: David envió mensajeros a los hombres de Jabes de Galaad para decirles: «Que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} {{plural_you:los|os}} bendiga, porque {{plural_you:mostraron|mostrasteis}} este amor fiel a {{plural_you:su|vuestro}} señor Saúl al darle sepultura.
es.R: David envió mensajeros a los hombres de Jabes de Galaad con este mensaje: «¡Que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} {{plural_you:los|os}} bendiga! {{plural_you:Ustedes mostraron|Vosotros mostrasteis}} amor fiel a Saúl, {{plural_you:su|vuestro}} señor, cuando lo {{plural_you:sepultaron|sepultasteis}}.

fr.L: Et David envoya des messagers aux hommes de Yabesh de Galaad, et leur dit : « Bénis [soyez]-vous par {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, vous qui avez fait cet amour loyal envers votre seigneur, envers Saül, et l’avez enseveli.
fr.B: David envoya des messagers aux hommes de Yabesh de Galaad pour leur dire : « Que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} vous bénisse, car vous avez montré cet amour fidèle à votre seigneur Saül en l’ensevelissant.
fr.R: David a envoyé des messagers aux hommes de Yabesh de Galaad avec ce message : « Que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} vous bénisse ! Vous avez montré un amour fidèle à Saül, votre maître, quand vous l’avez enterré.

sw.L: Daudi akatuma wajumbe kwa watu wa Yabeshi ya Gileadi akawaambia, "Mmebarikiwa [ninyi] na {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, ninyi mliomtendea bwana wenu, Sauli, upendo huu usiokoma, mkamzika.
sw.B: Daudi alituma wajumbe kwa watu wa Yabeshi ya Gileadi kuwaambia, "{{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} awabariki, kwa sababu mlimtendea bwana wenu Sauli fadhili hizi kwa kumzika.
sw.R: Daudi alituma wajumbe kwa watu wa Yabeshi ya Gileadi wakiwa na ujumbe huu: "{{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} awabariki! Mlimwonyesha fadhili Sauli, bwana wenu, mlipomzika.

vi.L: Đa-vít sai sứ giả đến cùng người Gia-be ở Ga-la-át và nói với họ: "Nguyện {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} ban phước cho các ngươi, là những người đã tỏ tình yêu thương thành tín này với chúa mình là Sau-lơ, và đã chôn cất người.
vi.B: Đa-vít sai sứ giả đến nói với người Gia-be ở Ga-la-át: "Nguyện {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} ban phước cho các ngươi, vì các ngươi đã tỏ lòng nhân từ với chúa mình là Sau-lơ mà chôn cất người.
vi.R: Đa-vít sai sứ giả đến nói với người Gia-be ở Ga-la-át: "Nguyện {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} ban phước cho các ngươi! Các ngươi đã tỏ lòng nhân từ với Sau-lơ, chủ của mình, khi chôn cất người.

ko.L: 그리고 다윗이 길르앗 야베스 사람들에게 사자들을 보내 그들에게 말했다. "너희가 너희 주, 곧 사울에게 이 한결같은 사랑을 베풀어 그를 장사 지냈으니, 너희는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 복을 받을 것이다.
ko.B: 다윗은 길르앗 야베스 사람들에게 사람들을 보내 이렇게 전했다. "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 여러분에게 복을 주시기를 바랍니다. 여러분은 여러분의 주인인 사울을 장사 지내어 그에게 이런 인애를 베풀었습니다.
ko.R: 다윗은 길르앗 야베스 사람들에게 사람들을 보내 이렇게 말을 전했다. "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 여러분에게 복을 주시기를 빕니다! 여러분은 여러분의 주인 사울을 묻어 주어서 그에게 인애를 보여 주었습니다.

pt.L: E Davi enviou mensageiros aos homens de Jabes-Gileade e lhes disse: "Benditos [sejam] vocês {{divine_name:pelo SENHOR|por Javé}}, vocês que fizeram esta lealdade com o seu senhor, com Saul, e o sepultaram.
pt.B: Davi enviou mensageiros aos homens de Jabes-Gileade para lhes dizer: "Que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} abençoe vocês, porque mostraram essa bondade leal ao seu senhor Saul, dando-lhe sepultura.
pt.R: Davi enviou mensageiros aos homens de Jabes-Gileade com esta mensagem: "Que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} abençoe vocês! Vocês foram bondosos e leais a Saul, o seu senhor, quando o sepultaram.

decisions.choice: blessed are you by the LORD: may the LORD bless you
decisions.reason: This is a set form of blessing, a wish that the LORD will do good to someone (Ruth 2:20; 3:10; 1 Samuel 23:21).

decisions.choice: steadfast love: loyalty kept to someone one is bound to
decisions.reason: The word names faithful kindness within a bond, here the bond of subjects to their king. They kept faith with Saul even after his death, as Ruth had with the dead of her family (Ruth 1:8).

decisions.choice: and buried him: the burial was the act of loyalty
decisions.reason: The last clause explains what "this steadfast love" was.

decisions.choice: faithful love
decisions.reason: As set for these books, Literal "steadfast love" and Balanced and Readable "faithful love" (Exodus 34:6). Readable says "master" for "lord" so it is not mistaken for God.

decisions.choice: amour loyal (L); amour fidèle (B, R)
decisions.reason: For the whole of 2 Samuel, as the Samuel terms note sets for *ḥesed*, also between people. Readable says "maître" for Saul, as the English "master", so that "seigneur" is not taken for God.

decisions.choice: "amor leal" (L); "amor fiel" (B, R)
decisions.reason: As the Samuel and Psalms terms notes set for ḥesed, also between people: "amor leal" at Literal, "amor fiel" at Balanced and Readable.

decisions.choice: upendo usiokoma (Literal); fadhili (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: *Hesed* is "upendo usiokoma" at Literal and "fadhili" at Balanced and Readable, as set for Samuel; here it is loyalty between people.

decisions.choice: "tình yêu thương thành tín" (L); "lòng nhân từ" (B, R) for *ḥesed* between people
decisions.reason: As the Samuel terms note sets: Literal keeps the word used for God's *ḥesed*, Balanced and Readable say kindness between people. The loyalty in it is shown by the deed, the burial (meaning decision).

decisions.choice: David says "các ngươi" to the men of Jabesh
decisions.reason: David speaks as the newly anointed king to subjects; the king says "ta" and "ngươi", as the Samuel terms note sets.

decisions.choice: *ḥesed* is "한결같은 사랑" at Literal and "인애" at Balanced and Readable, also between people
decisions.reason: As the Samuel terms note: one Korean word family for *ḥesed* throughout the book, here the loyalty the men of Jabesh kept to Saul.

decisions.choice: David's message to the men of Jabesh is in the formal polite style with "여러분" at Balanced and Readable; Literal keeps the plain style with "너희"
alternatives: the plain style at every level
decisions.reason: David writes as the new king of Judah to men of another region whose loyalty he wants to win; a respectful address fits the diplomatic letter better than commands.

decisions.choice: lealdade (L); bondade leal (B); foram bondosos e leais (R)
decisions.reason: Loyalty kept by subjects to their dead king (m2) takes the wording set for ḥesed between people in Ruth, Judges and 1 Samuel 15:6 in Portuguese; "amor leal" is kept for the LORD's, as in verse 6. David writes to the men of Jabesh with "vocês". Readable keeps "senhor" in lowercase, which Portuguese readers will not take for God, so the English change to "master" is not needed.

source.text: וְעַתָּ֕ה יַֽעַשׂ־יְהוָ֥ה עִמָּכֶ֖ם חֶ֣סֶד וֶאֱמֶ֑ת וְגַ֣ם אָנֹכִ֗י אֶעֱשֶׂ֤ה אִתְּכֶם֙ הַטּוֹבָ֣ה הַזֹּ֔את אֲשֶׁ֥ר עֲשִׂיתֶ֖ם הַדָּבָ֥ר הַזֶּֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And now may do Yahweh with you steadfast love and faithfulness; and also I will do with you this good, because you did this thing.

en.L: And now may {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} do steadfast love and faithfulness with you. And I also will do with you this good, because you have done this thing.
en.B: Now may {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} show you faithful love and truth. I too will treat you well, because you have done this.
en.R: Now may {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} show you {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} faithful love and be faithful to you. I will also be good to you because of what you did.

es.L: Y ahora haga {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} con {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} amor leal y fidelidad. Y también yo haré con {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} este bien, porque {{plural_you:hicieron|hicisteis}} esto.
es.B: Ahora, que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} {{plural_you:les|os}} muestre amor fiel y verdad. También yo {{plural_you:los|os}} trataré bien, porque {{plural_you:han hecho|habéis hecho}} esto.
es.R: Ahora, que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} {{plural_you:les|os}} muestre {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} amor fiel y {{plural_you:les|os}} sea fiel. Yo también seré bueno con {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} por lo que {{plural_you:hicieron|hicisteis}}.

fr.L: Et maintenant, que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} agisse envers vous avec amour loyal et fidélité. Et moi aussi je vous ferai ce bien, parce que vous avez fait cette chose.
fr.B: Maintenant, que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} agisse envers vous avec amour fidèle et vérité. Moi aussi, je vous traiterai bien, parce que vous avez agi ainsi.
fr.R: Maintenant, que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} vous montre {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} amour fidèle et vous reste fidèle. Moi aussi, je serai bon pour vous à cause de ce que vous avez fait.

sw.L: Basi sasa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} awatendee upendo usiokoma na uaminifu. Nami pia nitawatendea wema huu, kwa sababu mmefanya jambo hili.
sw.B: Sasa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} awaonyeshe fadhili na uaminifu. Nami pia nitawatendea mema, kwa sababu mmefanya jambo hili.
sw.R: Sasa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} awaonyeshe fadhili {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}} na kuwa mwaminifu kwenu. Nami pia nitawatendea mema kwa sababu ya jambo mlilofanya.

vi.L: Bây giờ, nguyện {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} tỏ tình yêu thương thành tín và sự thành tín với các ngươi. Ta cũng sẽ đối xử tốt với các ngươi, vì các ngươi đã làm điều này.
vi.B: Bây giờ, nguyện {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} tỏ tình yêu thương thành tín và chân thật với các ngươi. Ta cũng sẽ đối đãi tử tế với các ngươi, vì các ngươi đã làm việc này.
vi.R: Bây giờ, nguyện {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} tỏ tình thương thành tín của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} và luôn giữ lòng trung tín với các ngươi. Ta cũng sẽ đối xử tốt với các ngươi vì việc các ngươi đã làm.

ko.L: 그리고 이제 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 너희에게 한결같은 사랑과 신실하심을 베푸시기를 [바란다]. 그리고 나도 너희가 이 일을 했으니 너희에게 이 선을 베풀 것이다.

ko.R: 이제 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 여러분에게 그분의 인애를 보여 주시고, 여러분을 늘 신실하게 대해 주시기를 빕니다. 여러분이 한 일 때문에 나도 여러분에게 잘해 주겠습니다.

pt.B: Agora, que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} mostre a vocês amor leal e fidelidade. Eu também vou tratá-los bem, porque vocês fizeram isso.

decisions.choice: steadfast love and faithfulness: loyal kindness that can be relied on
decisions.reason: The two words often go together for the LORD's faithful care (Exodus 34:6; Genesis 24:27). David asks the LORD to repay them in kind for the loyalty they showed.

decisions.choice: this good: the good David himself will now do for them
alternatives: I will repay you for this good deed
decisions.reason: "This good" could point back to their deed, but the verb "I will do" makes it David's own promised kindness, matching what they did for Saul.

decisions.choice: I also: David as the new king promises his favor
decisions.reason: The promise prepares for verse 7, where David tells them he is now king of Judah.

decisions.choice: show you his faithful love and be faithful to you
decisions.reason: Readable turns the pair of nouns into two plain phrases, and supplies "his".

pt.B: Agora, então, sejam fortes e corajosos, porque Saul, o seu senhor, está morto, e a casa de Judá me ungiu rei sobre ela."

decisions.choice: let your hands be strong: take courage
decisions.reason: Strong hands stand for courage and resolve (Judges 7:11; 2 Samuel 16:21).

decisions.choice: sons of valor: brave and able men
decisions.reason: "Son of" a quality means a person marked by it.

decisions.choice: an unspoken invitation to accept David as king
decisions.reason: By setting Saul's death beside his own anointing, David suggests that the men of Jabesh-gilead should now look to him. He does not say it outright, and the translation leaves it unstated too.

decisions.choice: be strong and brave
decisions.reason: The two pictures are folded into one plain call to courage.

en.B: Meanwhile Abner son of Ner, the commander of Saul's army, had taken Saul's son Ish-bosheth and brought him across to Mahanaim.
en.R: Abner, the son of Ner, had been the army commander for Saul. He had taken Saul's son Ish-bosheth across the Jordan River to the town of Mahanaim.

es.R: Abner, hijo de Ner, había sido el jefe del ejército de Saúl. Había llevado a Isboset, hijo de Saúl, al otro lado del río Jordán, al pueblo de Mahanaim.

fr.B: Cependant Abner fils de Ner, chef de l’armée de Saül, avait pris Ishbosheth, fils de Saül, et l’avait fait passer à Mahanaïm.
fr.R: Abner, le fils de Ner, avait été le chef de l’armée de Saül. Il avait emmené Ishbosheth, le fils de Saül, de l’autre côté du Jourdain, dans la ville de Mahanaïm.

sw.L: Lakini Abneri mwana wa Neri, jemadari wa jeshi aliyekuwa wa Sauli, alikuwa amemchukua Ishboshethi mwana wa Sauli na kumvusha [mpaka] Mahanaimu.

ko.B: 한편 사울의 군대 사령관이던 넬의 아들 아브넬은 사울의 아들 이스보셋을 데리고 마하나임으로 건너갔다.

pt.B: Enquanto isso, Abner, filho de Ner, o comandante do exército de Saul, tinha tomado Is-Bosete, filho de Saul, e o tinha levado para o outro lado, a Maanaim.
pt.R: Abner, filho de Ner, tinha sido o comandante do exército de Saul. Ele tinha levado Is-Bosete, filho de Saul, para o outro lado do rio Jordão, para a cidade de Maanaim.

decisions.choice: Ish-bosheth: "man of shame", standing in Samuel for his name Eshbaal
decisions.reason: In 1 Chronicles 8:33 and 9:39 this son of Saul is called Eshbaal, "man of Baal" or "Baal exists". "Baal" means "lord" or "master" and could once be used of Israel's God, but it was also the name of the Canaanite god, so in Samuel the word "bosheth", "shame", stands in its place. The same change gives Mephibosheth (4:4) for Merib-baal (1 Chronicles 8:34) and Jerubbesheth (11:21) for Jerubbaal (Judges 6:32), and "the shame" stands for Baal in Jeremiah 3:24 and Hosea 9:10. The name is kept as the text of Samuel has it.

decisions.choice: had taken: told as background, at about the same time as David's anointing
decisions.reason: The sentence begins with Abner rather than with a verb, a Hebrew way of turning to another scene that runs alongside the first.

decisions.choice: Mahanaim: a town in Gilead, east of the Jordan
decisions.reason: Jacob named the place (Genesis 32:3), and it lay in the land of Gad (Joshua 13:26). It was far from the Philistines, who had taken towns west of the Jordan after Saul's defeat (1 Samuel 31:7). "Brought him over" means across the river.

decisions.choice: Abner: Saul's cousin and the commander of his army
decisions.reason: Abner's father Ner was Saul's uncle (1 Samuel 14:50-51). Now he, not the LORD or a prophet, is the one who makes Saul's son king.

decisions.choice: across the Jordan River to the town of Mahanaim
decisions.reason: Readable names the river the verb implies and says Mahanaim is a town. "Commander of the army" follows the wording set for these books (Readable "army commander").

decisions.choice: le chef de l'armée (every level)
decisions.reason: As the Samuel terms note sets for the commander of the army; French "chef de l'armée" is plain enough for Readable too.

decisions.choice: "Abner hijo de Ner", "Isboset", "Mahanaim"; "jefe del ejército"
decisions.reason: Names as the Samuel terms note ("Isboset", "Abner") and the Spanish Genesis ("Mahanaim", Genesis 32:3); "commander of the army" is "el jefe del ejército" at every level, as the terms note sets.

decisions.choice: jemadari wa jeshi (Literal); mkuu wa jeshi (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: "Commander of the army" as set for Samuel in Swahili.

decisions.choice: "Ích-bô-sết", "Nê-rơ", "Ma-ha-na-im"
decisions.reason: Ish-bosheth keeps the terms note's form at every level; his other name (meaning decision) is left to the English note. Ner and Mahanaim take the usual Protestant forms.

decisions.choice: "군대 사령관" for the commander of the army
decisions.reason: As the Samuel terms note; "장관" now means a government minister.

decisions.choice: Is-Bosete; Maanaim
decisions.reason: For the whole book: the son of Saul takes the name form the English uses, Ish-bosheth, in its Brazilian spelling "Is-Bosete", with the hyphen that keeps "Is" ("man") and "Bosete" ("shame") apart as the meaning note explains them (m1); the form "Esbaal" of 1 Chronicles 8:33 is left to that note. "Maanaim" is the form of Genesis 32:3 and Joshua 13:26 in Portuguese (m3). "Abner, filho de Ner" as 1 Samuel 14:50.

records.literal_gloss: And he made him king to the Gilead and to the Ashurite and to Jezreel and over Ephraim and over Benjamin and over Israel, all of it.

en.L: And he made him king for Gilead and for the Ashurites and for Jezreel, and over Ephraim and over Benjamin and over Israel, all of it.
en.B: He made him king over Gilead, the Ashurites and Jezreel, over Ephraim and Benjamin, and over all Israel.
en.R: Abner made Ish-bosheth king of Gilead, of the Ashurites and of Jezreel, and of Ephraim and Benjamin. He became king over all Israel.

es.L: Y lo hizo rey para Galaad y para los asureos y para Jezreel, y sobre Efraín y sobre Benjamín y sobre Israel, todo él.
es.B: Lo hizo rey sobre Galaad, los asureos y Jezreel, sobre Efraín y Benjamín, y sobre todo Israel.
es.R: Abner hizo a Isboset rey de Galaad, de los asureos y de Jezreel, y de Efraín y Benjamín. Llegó a ser rey sobre todo Israel.

sw.B: Alimfanya mfalme juu ya Gileadi, Waashuri na Yezreeli, juu ya Efraimu na Benyamini, na juu ya Israeli yote.
sw.R: Abneri akamfanya Ishboshethi mfalme wa Gileadi, wa Waashuri na wa Yezreeli, na wa Efraimu na Benyamini. Akawa mfalme juu ya Israeli yote.

vi.L: Ông lập người làm vua cho Ga-la-át, cho người A-su-rơ và cho Gít-rê-ên, và trên Ép-ra-im, trên Bên-gia-min và trên Y-sơ-ra-ên, toàn thể.

vi.R: Áp-ne lập Ích-bô-sết làm vua cai trị Ga-la-át, người A-su-rơ, Gít-rê-ên, Ép-ra-im và Bên-gia-min. Ích-bô-sết làm vua trên toàn cõi Y-sơ-ra-ên.

ko.L: 그리고 그가 그를 길르앗과 아술 사람들과 이스르엘과 에브라임과 베냐민과 이스라엘 전체의 왕으로 삼았다.
ko.B: 아브넬은 그를 길르앗과 아술 사람들과 이스르엘, 에브라임과 베냐민, 그리고 온 이스라엘의 왕으로 세웠다.
ko.R: 아브넬은 이스보셋을 길르앗과 아술 사람들과 이스르엘, 그리고 에브라임과 베냐민의 왕으로 세웠다. 이렇게 이스보셋은 온 이스라엘의 왕이 되었다.

pt.L: E ele o fez rei para Gileade, e para os assuritas, e para Jezreel, e sobre Efraim, e sobre Benjamim, e sobre Israel, todo ele.
pt.B: Ele o fez rei sobre Gileade, os assuritas e Jezreel, sobre Efraim e Benjamim, e sobre todo o Israel.
pt.R: Abner fez Is-Bosete rei de Gileade, dos assuritas e de Jezreel, e de Efraim e de Benjamim. Ele se tornou rei de todo o Israel.

decisions.choice: the Ashurites: a people not otherwise known; perhaps the tribe of Asher
decisions.reason: The name does not mean Assyria. A people in the north between Gilead and Jezreel is expected, and the tribe of Asher fits, as one early Aramaic translation reads. Some other early translations (Syriac and Latin) read "Geshurites", but Geshur had its own king (3:3), so that is less likely. The Hebrew form is kept; reviewers should check the ancient versions.

decisions.choice: Jezreel: here the broad valley in the north
decisions.reason: This is the great valley between Galilee and the hills of Ephraim (Joshua 17:16), not the town of Judah in verse 2.

decisions.choice: and over Israel, all of it: a summary of the whole kingdom apart from Judah
decisions.reason: After naming regions and tribes, the list sums them up as all Israel. The list changes its preposition partway through, from one meaning "to" or "for" to one meaning "over", but this does not seem to change the sense.

decisions.choice: Abner made Ish-bosheth king ... He became king over all Israel.
decisions.reason: Readable names both men and makes the summary its own sentence.

decisions.choice: os assuritas
decisions.reason: The name is kept as the text has it (m1), in the usual Brazilian form; it does not mean the Assyrians, "os assírios", and the readings "Asher" and "Geshurites" are left to the meaning note, as the English does.

records.literal_gloss: A son of forty years [was] Ish-bosheth son of Saul when he became king over Israel, and two years he reigned. Only [the] house of Judah were after David.

en.L: Ish-bosheth son of Saul [was] a son of forty years when he became king over Israel, and he reigned two years. Only the house of Judah were after David.
en.B: Ish-bosheth son of Saul was forty years old when he became king over Israel, and he reigned two years. Only the house of Judah followed David.
en.R: Ish-bosheth was forty years old when he became king over Israel, and he ruled for two years. But the people of Judah were loyal to David.

es.L: Hijo de cuarenta años [era] Isboset hijo de Saúl cuando comenzó a reinar sobre Israel, y reinó dos años. Solo la casa de Judá estaba tras David.
es.B: Isboset hijo de Saúl tenía cuarenta años cuando comenzó a reinar sobre Israel, y reinó dos años. Solo la casa de Judá siguió a David.
es.R: Isboset tenía cuarenta años cuando llegó a ser rey de Israel, y gobernó durante dos años. Pero el pueblo de Judá se mantuvo fiel a David.

fr.L: Ishbosheth fils de Saül [était] fils de quarante ans quand il devint roi sur Israël, et il régna deux ans. Seule la maison de Juda était derrière David.
fr.B: Ishbosheth, fils de Saül, avait quarante ans quand il devint roi sur Israël, et il régna deux ans. Seule la maison de Juda suivit David.
fr.R: Ishbosheth avait quarante ans quand il est devenu roi sur Israël, et il a régné pendant deux ans. Mais le peuple de Juda est resté fidèle à David.

sw.L: Ishboshethi mwana wa Sauli [alikuwa] mwana wa miaka arobaini alipoanza kutawala juu ya Israeli, naye akatawala miaka miwili. Ila nyumba ya Yuda tu walikuwa nyuma ya Daudi.
sw.B: Ishboshethi mwana wa Sauli alikuwa na umri wa miaka arobaini alipoanza kutawala juu ya Israeli, naye akatawala miaka miwili. Ila nyumba ya Yuda tu ndiyo iliyomfuata Daudi.
sw.R: Ishboshethi alikuwa na umri wa miaka arobaini alipokuwa mfalme wa Israeli, naye akatawala kwa miaka miwili. Lakini watu wa Yuda walibaki waaminifu kwa Daudi.

vi.L: Ích-bô-sết con trai Sau-lơ [được] bốn mươi tuổi khi làm vua cai trị Y-sơ-ra-ên, và ông trị vì hai năm. Chỉ có nhà Giu-đa theo Đa-vít.
vi.B: Ích-bô-sết con trai Sau-lơ được bốn mươi tuổi khi lên làm vua Y-sơ-ra-ên, và ông trị vì hai năm. Chỉ có nhà Giu-đa theo Đa-vít.
vi.R: Ích-bô-sết được bốn mươi tuổi khi lên làm vua Y-sơ-ra-ên, và ông cai trị được hai năm. Nhưng người Giu-đa vẫn trung thành với Đa-vít.

ko.L: 사울의 아들 이스보셋은 이스라엘을 다스리는 왕이 되었을 때 사십 세[였고], 이 년 동안 다스렸다. 다만 유다 집은 다윗을 따랐다.
ko.B: 사울의 아들 이스보셋은 이스라엘의 왕이 되었을 때 마흔 살이었고, 두 해 동안 다스렸다. 그러나 유다 집안만은 다윗을 따랐다.
ko.R: 이스보셋은 마흔 살에 이스라엘의 왕이 되어 두 해 동안 다스렸다. 그러나 유다 사람들은 다윗에게 충성했다.

pt.L: Is-Bosete, filho de Saul, [era] filho de quarenta anos quando começou a reinar sobre Israel, e reinou dois anos. Somente a casa de Judá estava com Davi.
pt.B: Is-Bosete, filho de Saul, tinha quarenta anos quando começou a reinar sobre Israel, e reinou dois anos. Só a casa de Judá seguia Davi.
pt.R: Is-Bosete tinha quarenta anos quando se tornou rei de Israel, e governou durante dois anos. Mas o povo de Judá era fiel a Davi.

decisions.choice: a son of forty years: forty years old
decisions.reason: This is the usual Hebrew way of giving a person's age.

decisions.choice: two years: shorter than David's seven and a half years in Hebron (verse 11)
decisions.reason: The text does not explain the difference. Ish-bosheth may have been made king some years after Saul's death, once Abner had won back the land from the Philistines, or the two years may count only part of the time before David became king of all Israel (5:1-5).

decisions.choice: were after David: followed David as their king
decisions.reason: To be "after" someone is to follow them as leader (1 Kings 12:20).

decisions.choice: was ... when he became king over Israel, and he reigned two years
decisions.reason: This is the wording set for the regnal formula in these books. Readable says "ruled" and "were loyal to".

decisions.choice: tinha quarenta anos quando começou a reinar ... e reinou dois anos
alternatives: era da idade de quarenta anos
decisions.reason: For the whole book: the regnal formula is "tinha N anos quando começou a reinar ... e reinou N anos" at Balanced (Literal keeps "filho de N anos"), so that the formula reads the same for every king. Literal says "estava com Davi" for "were after David" (m3), since "atrás de Davi" would mean behind him in space; Balanced says "seguia".

source.text: וַֽיְהִי֙ מִסְפַּ֣ר הַיָּמִ֔ים אֲשֶׁר֩ הָיָ֨ה דָוִ֥ד מֶ֛לֶךְ בְּחֶבְר֖וֹן עַל־בֵּ֣ית יְהוּדָ֑ה שֶׁ֥בַע שָׁנִ֖ים וְשִׁשָּׁ֥ה חֳדָשִֽׁים׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And was the number of the days that was David king in Hebron over [the] house of Judah seven years and six months.

en.L: And the number of the days that David was king in Hebron over the house of Judah was seven years and six months.
en.B: David was king in Hebron over the house of Judah for seven years and six months.
en.R: David ruled over Judah from Hebron for seven and a half years.

es.L: Y fue el número de los días que David fue rey en Hebrón sobre la casa de Judá siete años y seis meses.
es.B: David fue rey en Hebrón sobre la casa de Judá durante siete años y seis meses.
es.R: David gobernó sobre Judá desde Hebrón durante siete años y medio.

fr.L: Et le nombre des jours où David fut roi à Hébron sur la maison de Juda fut de sept ans et six mois.
fr.B: David fut roi à Hébron sur la maison de Juda pendant sept ans et six mois.
fr.R: David a régné sur Juda depuis Hébron pendant sept ans et demi.

sw.L: Na hesabu ya siku ambazo Daudi alikuwa mfalme katika Hebroni juu ya nyumba ya Yuda ilikuwa miaka saba na miezi sita.
sw.B: Daudi alikuwa mfalme huko Hebroni juu ya nyumba ya Yuda kwa miaka saba na miezi sita.
sw.R: Daudi alitawala Yuda akiwa Hebroni kwa miaka saba na nusu.

vi.L: Số ngày Đa-vít làm vua tại Hếp-rôn cai trị nhà Giu-đa là bảy năm sáu tháng.
vi.B: Đa-vít làm vua cai trị nhà Giu-đa tại Hếp-rôn được bảy năm sáu tháng.
vi.R: Đa-vít cai trị Giu-đa tại Hếp-rôn được bảy năm rưỡi.

ko.L: 그리고 다윗이 헤브론에서 유다 집의 왕으로 있었던 날수가 칠 년 여섯 달이었다.
ko.B: 다윗은 헤브론에서 일곱 해 여섯 달 동안 유다 집안의 왕으로 있었다.
ko.R: 다윗은 헤브론에서 칠 년 반 동안 유다를 다스렸다.

pt.L: E o número dos dias em que Davi foi rei em Hebrom sobre a casa de Judá foi sete anos e seis meses.
pt.B: Davi foi rei em Hebrom sobre a casa de Judá durante sete anos e seis meses.
pt.R: Davi governou Judá a partir de Hebrom durante sete anos e meio.

decisions.choice: the number of the days: the length of time
decisions.reason: "Days" here means a span of time.

decisions.choice: seven years and six months: repeated when David's reign is summed up
decisions.reason: The same length is given in 5:5 and 1 Chronicles 3:4; 1 Kings 2:11 rounds it to seven years.

decisions.choice: seven and a half years
decisions.reason: Readable uses the simpler phrase for the same length of time.

source.text: וַיֵּצֵא֙ אַבְנֵ֣ר בֶּן־נֵ֔ר וְעַבְדֵ֖י אִֽישׁ־בֹּ֣שֶׁת בֶּן־שָׁא֑וּל מִֽמַּחֲנַ֖יִם גִּבְעֽוֹנָה׃

records.literal_gloss: And went out Abner son of Ner and [the] servants of Ish-bosheth son of Saul from Mahanaim to Gibeon.

en.L: And Abner son of Ner went out, and the servants of Ish-bosheth son of Saul, from Mahanaim to Gibeon.
en.B: Abner son of Ner set out from Mahanaim for Gibeon with the men of Ish-bosheth son of Saul.
en.R: Abner, the son of Ner, marched from Mahanaim to Gibeon with the soldiers of Saul's son Ish-bosheth.

es.L: Y salió Abner hijo de Ner, y los siervos de Isboset hijo de Saúl, de Mahanaim a Gabaón.
es.B: Abner hijo de Ner salió de Mahanaim hacia Gabaón con los hombres de Isboset hijo de Saúl.
es.R: Abner, hijo de Ner, marchó de Mahanaim a Gabaón con los soldados de Isboset, hijo de Saúl.

fr.L: Et Abner fils de Ner sortit, ainsi que les serviteurs d’Ishbosheth fils de Saül, de Mahanaïm vers Gabaon.
fr.B: Abner fils de Ner partit de Mahanaïm pour Gabaon avec les hommes d’Ishbosheth, fils de Saül.
fr.R: Abner, le fils de Ner, est parti de Mahanaïm et s’est avancé jusqu’à Gabaon avec les soldats d’Ishbosheth, le fils de Saül.

sw.L: Abneri mwana wa Neri akatoka, na watumishi wa Ishboshethi mwana wa Sauli, kutoka Mahanaimu mpaka Gibeoni.
sw.B: Abneri mwana wa Neri aliondoka Mahanaimu kwenda Gibeoni pamoja na watu wa Ishboshethi mwana wa Sauli.
sw.R: Abneri mwana wa Neri alikwenda pamoja na askari wa Ishboshethi mwana wa Sauli kutoka Mahanaimu mpaka Gibeoni.

vi.L: Áp-ne con trai Nê-rơ cùng các đầy tớ của Ích-bô-sết con trai Sau-lơ kéo ra từ Ma-ha-na-im đến Ga-ba-ôn.
vi.B: Áp-ne con trai Nê-rơ cùng quân của Ích-bô-sết con trai Sau-lơ rời Ma-ha-na-im kéo đến Ga-ba-ôn.
vi.R: Áp-ne con trai Nê-rơ dẫn binh lính của Ích-bô-sết, con trai Sau-lơ, từ Ma-ha-na-im kéo đến Ga-ba-ôn.

ko.L: 그리고 넬의 아들 아브넬과 사울의 아들 이스보셋의 신하들이 마하나임에서 기브온으로 나갔다.
ko.B: 넬의 아들 아브넬은 사울의 아들 이스보셋의 부하들을 거느리고 마하나임에서 기브온으로 나아갔다.
ko.R: 넬의 아들 아브넬은 사울의 아들 이스보셋의 군인들을 데리고 마하나임에서 기브온으로 진군했다.

pt.L: E Abner, filho de Ner, saiu, e os servos de Is-Bosete, filho de Saul, de Maanaim para Gibeom.
pt.B: Abner, filho de Ner, partiu de Maanaim para Gibeom com os homens de Is-Bosete, filho de Saul.
pt.R: Abner, filho de Ner, marchou de Maanaim até Gibeom com os soldados de Is-Bosete, filho de Saul.

decisions.choice: went out: marched out to battle
decisions.reason: "Go out" is often said of an army taking the field (1 Samuel 8:20; 18:30).

decisions.choice: Gibeon: a town of Benjamin near the border of Judah
decisions.reason: Gibeon lay a few miles northwest of Jerusalem (Joshua 9:3; 18:25). Abner leads his army back across the Jordan toward David's territory.

decisions.choice: the servants of Ish-bosheth: the king's fighting men
decisions.reason: A king's "servants" can be his officials or, as here and in verses 13, 15, 17 and 30-31, his soldiers.

decisions.choice: men (Balanced); soldiers (Readable)
decisions.reason: Here the king's "servants" are his fighting men, so Balanced says "men" and Readable "soldiers"; Literal keeps "servants".

decisions.choice: les serviteurs (L); les hommes (B); les soldats (R); Gabaon
decisions.reason: A king's "servants" here are his fighting men (m3), as the English says. The town takes its usual French name, Gabaon.

decisions.choice: "los siervos" (L); "los hombres" (B); "los soldados" (R); "Gabaón"
decisions.reason: The king's servants as his fighting men follow the English levels; Gibeon takes its usual Spanish form "Gabaón".

decisions.choice: "các đầy tớ" (L); "quân" (B); "binh lính" (R) for the king's servants as his fighting men
decisions.reason: Here the servants are soldiers (meaning decision), not court officials, so Balanced and Readable name them as troops; the same holds for "the servants of David" through the chapter.

decisions.choice: os servos (L); os homens (B); os soldados (R)
decisions.reason: For the whole book, as the English: a king's "servants" who are his fighting men (m3) are "os servos" at Literal, "os homens" at Balanced and "os soldados" at Readable, in this chapter and wherever the context makes them soldiers. "Gibeom" is the form of Joshua 9-10 in Portuguese.

source.text: וְיוֹאָ֨ב בֶּן־צְרוּיָ֜ה וְעַבְדֵ֤י דָוִד֙ יָֽצְא֔וּ וַֽיִּפְגְּשׁ֛וּם עַל־בְּרֵכַ֥ת גִּבְע֖וֹן יַחְדָּ֑ו וַיֵּ֨שְׁב֜וּ אֵ֤לֶּה עַל־הַבְּרֵכָה֙ מִזֶּ֔ה וְאֵ֥לֶּה עַל־הַבְּרֵכָ֖ה מִזֶּֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And Joab son of Zeruiah and [the] servants of David went out, and they met them by [the] pool of Gibeon together; and they sat, these by the pool on this [side] and these by the pool on this [side].

en.L: And Joab son of Zeruiah and the servants of David went out, and they met them together at the pool of Gibeon. And they sat down, these at the pool on this [side] and those at the pool on that [side].
en.B: Joab son of Zeruiah and David's men also went out, and the two forces met at the pool of Gibeon. They sat down across the pool from each other, one group on each side.
en.R: Joab, the son of Zeruiah, also marched out with David's soldiers. The two armies met at the pool in Gibeon. Abner's men sat down on one side of the pool, and Joab's men faced them from the other side.

es.L: Y Joab hijo de Sarvia y los siervos de David salieron, y se encontraron con ellos junto al estanque de Gabaón. Y se sentaron, estos junto al estanque de este [lado] y aquellos junto al estanque del otro [lado].
es.B: Joab hijo de Sarvia y los hombres de David también salieron, y las dos fuerzas se encontraron en el estanque de Gabaón. Se sentaron frente a frente, un grupo a cada lado del estanque.
es.R: Joab, hijo de Sarvia, también salió con los soldados de David. Los dos ejércitos se encontraron en el estanque de Gabaón. Los hombres de Abner se sentaron a un lado del estanque, y los de Joab se pusieron frente a ellos al otro lado.

fr.L: Et Joab fils de Tserouya et les serviteurs de David sortirent, et ils les rencontrèrent ensemble près de l’étang de Gabaon. Et ils s’assirent, ceux-ci près de l’étang d’un côté, et ceux-là près de l’étang de l’autre côté.
fr.B: Joab fils de Tserouya et les hommes de David sortirent aussi, et les deux troupes se rencontrèrent près de l’étang de Gabaon. Ils s’assirent face à face, de part et d’autre de l’étang.
fr.R: Joab, le fils de Tserouya, s’est aussi mis en marche avec les soldats de David. Les deux armées se sont rencontrées près de l’étang de Gabaon. Les hommes d’Abner se sont assis d’un côté de l’étang, et les hommes de Joab se sont installés en face, de l’autre côté.

sw.L: Yoabu mwana wa Seruya na watumishi wa Daudi wakatoka, wakakutana nao pamoja kwenye bwawa la Gibeoni. Wakaketi, hawa kwenye bwawa upande huu, na hao kwenye bwawa upande ule.
sw.B: Yoabu mwana wa Seruya na watu wa Daudi nao walitoka, na majeshi hayo mawili yakakutana kwenye bwawa la Gibeoni. Wakaketi wakielekeana, kundi moja kila upande wa bwawa.
sw.R: Yoabu mwana wa Seruya naye alitoka pamoja na askari wa Daudi. Majeshi hayo mawili yakakutana kwenye bwawa la Gibeoni. Watu wa Abneri wakaketi upande mmoja wa bwawa, na watu wa Yoabu wakaketi upande mwingine wakiwaelekea.

vi.L: Giô-áp con trai Xê-ru-gia và các đầy tớ của Đa-vít cũng kéo ra, và họ gặp nhau tại ao Ga-ba-ôn. Họ ngồi xuống, bên này ở bên ao phía này, bên kia ở bên ao phía kia.
vi.B: Giô-áp con trai Xê-ru-gia và quân của Đa-vít cũng kéo ra, và hai bên gặp nhau tại ao Ga-ba-ôn. Họ ngồi xuống hai bên bờ ao, mỗi bên một phía.
vi.R: Giô-áp con trai Xê-ru-gia cũng dẫn binh lính của Đa-vít kéo ra. Hai đạo quân gặp nhau tại cái ao ở Ga-ba-ôn. Quân của Áp-ne ngồi một bên bờ ao, còn quân của Giô-áp ngồi đối diện ở bờ bên kia.

ko.L: 그리고 스루야의 아들 요압과 다윗의 신하들도 나가서, 기브온 못가에서 그들과 함께 마주쳤다. 그리고 그들이 앉았는데, 이들은 못 이쪽에, 저들은 못 저쪽에 [앉았다].
ko.B: 스루야의 아들 요압과 다윗의 부하들도 나가서, 두 군대가 기브온 못가에서 마주쳤다. 그들은 못을 사이에 두고 이쪽과 저쪽에 마주 앉았다.
ko.R: 스루야의 아들 요압도 다윗의 군인들을 데리고 나갔다. 두 군대는 기브온에 있는 못가에서 만났다. 아브넬의 부하들은 못 한쪽에 앉았고, 요압의 부하들은 맞은편에 앉았다.

pt.L: E Joabe, filho de Zeruia, e os servos de Davi saíram, e os encontraram juntos no tanque de Gibeom. E sentaram-se, estes junto ao tanque de um lado, e aqueles junto ao tanque do outro lado.
pt.B: Joabe, filho de Zeruia, e os homens de Davi também saíram, e as duas forças se encontraram no tanque de Gibeom. Eles se sentaram de frente uns para os outros, um grupo de cada lado do tanque.
pt.R: Joabe, filho de Zeruia, também saiu com os soldados de Davi. Os dois exércitos se encontraram no tanque de Gibeom. Os homens de Abner se sentaram de um lado do tanque, e os homens de Joabe ficaram de frente para eles, do outro lado.

decisions.choice: Joab son of Zeruiah: David's nephew
decisions.reason: Zeruiah was David's sister (1 Chronicles 2:16), and her three sons are named after her (verse 18). Joab already led David's men.

decisions.choice: the pool of Gibeon: a large water source at Gibeon
decisions.reason: Jeremiah 41:12 also speaks of "the great waters" at Gibeon. It was a natural meeting place for two forces.

decisions.choice: together: the two sides came to the same place
decisions.reason: The word says that they met each other there, not that they arrived at the same moment.

decisions.choice: David's men (Balanced); David's soldiers (Readable)
decisions.reason: As in verse 12.

decisions.choice: Abner's men ... Joab's men
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says "these ... and these". Readable names the two groups; the text does not say which side each sat on, and the choice here changes nothing.

decisions.choice: "다윗의 신하들" at Literal; "다윗의 부하들" (Balanced) and "다윗의 군인들" (Readable) where *ʿavde David* are his fighting men
decisions.reason: "신하" is a court official; on the battlefield Balanced and Readable say men or soldiers, as the English levels do. "왕의 신하들" stays for the king's officials at court.

decisions.choice: Joabe, filho de Zeruia; o tanque de Gibeom
decisions.reason: For the whole book: Joab is "Joabe", as in the shared list for 1 Samuel, and his mother, David's sister (m1), "Zeruia", the usual Brazilian form, so her three sons are "os filhos de Zeruia" (verse 18). The pool is "o tanque de Gibeom" (m2): "tanque" is the Portuguese word for a large built reservoir of water; "piscina" now means a swimming pool.

source.text: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אַבְנֵר֙ אֶל־יוֹאָ֔ב יָק֤וּמוּ נָא֙ הַנְּעָרִ֔ים וִֽישַׂחֲק֖וּ לְפָנֵ֑ינוּ וַיֹּ֥אמֶר יוֹאָ֖ב יָקֻֽמוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: And said Abner to Joab, Let arise please the young men and let them play before us. And said Joab, Let them arise.

en.L: And Abner said to Joab, "Let the young men arise, please, and let them play before us." And Joab said, "Let them arise."
en.B: Then Abner said to Joab, "Let some of the young men get up and hold a contest in front of us." Joab answered, "Let them get up."
en.R: Abner said to Joab, "Let some of our young soldiers fight each other while we watch." Joab said, "All right, let them."

es.L: Y dijo Abner a Joab: «Que se levanten, te ruego, los jóvenes y que jueguen delante de nosotros». Y dijo Joab: «Que se levanten».
es.B: Entonces Abner le dijo a Joab: «Que se levanten algunos de los jóvenes y hagan un combate delante de nosotros». Joab respondió: «Que se levanten».
es.R: Abner le dijo a Joab: «Que algunos de nuestros soldados jóvenes luchen entre sí mientras nosotros miramos». Joab dijo: «Está bien, que lo hagan».

fr.L: Et Abner dit à Joab : « Que les jeunes gens se lèvent, je te prie, et qu’ils jouent devant nous. » Et Joab dit : « Qu’ils se lèvent. »
fr.B: Alors Abner dit à Joab : « Que quelques jeunes gens se lèvent et se mesurent devant nous. » Joab répondit : « Qu’ils se lèvent. »
fr.R: Abner a dit à Joab : « Que quelques-uns de nos jeunes soldats se battent les uns contre les autres pendant que nous regardons. » Joab a dit : « D’accord, qu’ils le fassent. »

sw.L: Abneri akamwambia Yoabu, "Tafadhali vijana na wainuke wacheze mbele yetu." Yoabu akasema, "Na wainuke."
sw.B: Kisha Abneri akamwambia Yoabu, "Baadhi ya vijana wainuke wafanye shindano mbele yetu." Yoabu akajibu, "Na wainuke."
sw.R: Abneri akamwambia Yoabu, "Baadhi ya askari wetu vijana wapigane wao kwa wao, nasi tutazame." Yoabu akasema, "Sawa, na wapigane."

vi.L: Áp-ne nói với Giô-áp: "Hãy cho các thanh niên đứng dậy đấu chơi trước mặt chúng ta." Giô-áp nói: "Cho họ đứng dậy."
vi.B: Bấy giờ Áp-ne nói với Giô-áp: "Hãy cho vài thanh niên đứng ra so tài trước mặt chúng ta." Giô-áp đáp: "Được, cho họ ra."
vi.R: Áp-ne nói với Giô-áp: "Hãy cho một số lính trẻ của hai bên đấu với nhau cho chúng ta xem." Giô-áp nói: "Được, cứ cho họ đấu."

ko.L: 그리고 아브넬이 요압에게 말했다. "부디 젊은이들이 일어나 우리 앞에서 겨루게 하자." 그러자 요압이 말했다. "일어나게 하자."
ko.B: 그때 아브넬이 요압에게 말했다. "젊은이들을 몇 명 일으켜 우리 앞에서 겨루게 하자." 요압이 대답했다. "그렇게 하자."
ko.R: 아브넬이 요압에게 말했다. "우리 젊은 군인들끼리 싸우게 하고 우리는 구경하자." 요압이 말했다. "좋다, 그렇게 하자."

pt.L: E Abner disse a Joabe: "Levantem-se os jovens, por favor, e joguem diante de nós." E Joabe disse: "Que se levantem."
pt.B: Então Abner disse a Joabe: "Que alguns dos jovens se levantem e façam uma disputa de armas diante de nós." Joabe respondeu: "Que se levantem."
pt.R: Abner disse a Joabe: "Vamos deixar alguns dos nossos jovens soldados lutarem uns contra os outros enquanto nós assistimos." Joabe disse: "Está bem, que lutem."

decisions.choice: play: hold a contest of arms, staged like a sport
decisions.reason: The verb means play, sport or entertain (Judges 16:25). Here it names combat between chosen fighters before the two leaders. Whether it was meant as a show of skill or as a fight between champions to settle the matter, as Goliath proposed (1 Samuel 17:8-9), is not said; it ends in death either way (verse 16).

decisions.choice: young men: young fighting men
decisions.reason: The word for young men is often used for soldiers (1 Samuel 21:3; 25:5).

decisions.choice: please: a polite word that softens the proposal
decisions.reason: Abner frames the deadly contest as a courteous suggestion.

decisions.choice: hold a contest (Balanced); fight each other while we watch (Readable)
decisions.reason: "Play" alone would hide that this was armed combat. Balanced keeps the sense of a staged event; Readable says plainly what happened. Both drop the softening "please".

decisions.choice: "đấu chơi" (L); "so tài" (B); "đấu với nhau cho chúng ta xem" (R)
decisions.reason: The play is a contest of arms staged like a sport (meaning decision); Vietnamese "chơi" alone would sound like a game, so each level names a contest.

decisions.choice: Abner and Joab, the two rival commanders, speak to each other in the plain style (해라체)
decisions.reason: They are equals in rank and enemies in the field; the plain style keeps their speech blunt, as the scene in verses 14-27 needs.

decisions.choice: joguem (L); façam uma disputa de armas (B); lutem uns contra os outros enquanto nós assistimos (R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew "play" with "jogar", the verb of games and sport, which lets the reader hear how lightly Abner speaks of a deadly contest (m1); "brincar" would make it a children's game. Balanced names an armed contest, as the English does, and Readable says what happened. Abner and Joab, commanders of equal rank, speak to each other with "você" (verses 20-27).

source.text: וַיָּקֻ֖מוּ וַיַּעַבְר֣וּ בְמִסְפָּ֑ר שְׁנֵ֧ים עָשָׂ֣ר לְבִנְיָמִ֗ן וּלְאִ֥ישׁ בֹּ֨שֶׁת֙ בֶּן־שָׁא֔וּל וּשְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָׂ֖ר מֵעַבְדֵ֥י דָוִֽד׃

records.literal_gloss: And they arose and passed over by number, twelve for Benjamin and for Ish-bosheth son of Saul, and twelve of [the] servants of David.

en.L: And they arose and passed over by number: twelve for Benjamin and for Ish-bosheth son of Saul, and twelve of the servants of David.
en.B: So they got up and went forward one by one as they were counted: twelve for Benjamin and Ish-bosheth son of Saul, and twelve of David's men.
en.R: So twelve men from Benjamin stepped forward to fight for Ish-bosheth, Saul's son, and twelve of David's soldiers stepped forward too. They were counted as they came.

es.L: Y se levantaron y pasaron por número: doce por Benjamín y por Isboset hijo de Saúl, y doce de los siervos de David.
es.B: Así que se levantaron y avanzaron uno por uno mientras los contaban: doce por Benjamín y por Isboset hijo de Saúl, y doce de los hombres de David.
es.R: Así que doce hombres de Benjamín dieron un paso al frente para luchar por Isboset, hijo de Saúl, y también doce soldados de David. Los fueron contando a medida que avanzaban.

fr.L: Et ils se levèrent et passèrent selon le nombre : douze pour Benjamin et pour Ishbosheth fils de Saül, et douze des serviteurs de David.
fr.B: Ils se levèrent donc et s’avancèrent un à un, comptés à mesure : douze pour Benjamin et pour Ishbosheth fils de Saül, et douze des hommes de David.
fr.R: Alors douze hommes de Benjamin se sont avancés pour combattre pour Ishbosheth, le fils de Saül, et douze soldats de David se sont avancés aussi. On les comptait à mesure qu’ils arrivaient.

sw.L: Wakainuka wakavuka kwa hesabu: kumi na wawili kwa ajili ya Benyamini na kwa ajili ya Ishboshethi mwana wa Sauli, na kumi na wawili wa watumishi wa Daudi.
sw.B: Basi wakainuka, wakasogea mbele mmoja mmoja walipokuwa wakihesabiwa: kumi na wawili kwa ajili ya Benyamini na Ishboshethi mwana wa Sauli, na kumi na wawili wa watu wa Daudi.
sw.R: Basi watu kumi na wawili wa Benyamini wakasogea mbele kumpigania Ishboshethi mwana wa Sauli, na askari kumi na wawili wa Daudi nao wakasogea mbele. Walihesabiwa kila mmoja alipokuja.

vi.L: Họ đứng dậy và bước qua theo số: mười hai người cho Bên-gia-min và cho Ích-bô-sết con trai Sau-lơ, và mười hai người trong các đầy tớ của Đa-vít.
vi.B: Vậy họ đứng dậy, lần lượt bước ra theo số đã đếm: mười hai người phe Bên-gia-min và Ích-bô-sết con trai Sau-lơ, và mười hai người của Đa-vít.
vi.R: Vậy mười hai người Bên-gia-min bước ra để đấu cho Ích-bô-sết, con trai Sau-lơ, và mười hai lính của Đa-vít cũng bước ra. Người ta đếm từng người khi họ bước ra.

ko.L: 그리고 그들이 일어나 수대로 나아갔는데, 베냐민과 사울의 아들 이스보셋을 위해 열둘, 다윗의 신하들 가운데서 열둘이었다.
ko.B: 그래서 그들이 일어나 수를 세며 하나씩 나아갔다. 베냐민과 사울의 아들 이스보셋 쪽에서 열두 명, 다윗의 부하들 가운데서 열두 명이었다.
ko.R: 베냐민 사람 열두 명이 사울의 아들 이스보셋을 위해 싸우려고 앞으로 나왔다. 다윗의 군인들 가운데서도 열두 명이 나왔다. 그들이 나올 때 하나하나 수를 세었다.

pt.L: E eles se levantaram e passaram em número contado: doze por Benjamim e por Is-Bosete, filho de Saul, e doze dos servos de Davi.
pt.B: Eles se levantaram e passaram à frente um a um, à medida que eram contados: doze por Benjamim e por Is-Bosete, filho de Saul, e doze dos homens de Davi.
pt.R: Então doze homens de Benjamim avançaram para lutar por Is-Bosete, filho de Saul, e doze dos soldados de Davi também avançaram. Eles foram contados à medida que vinham.

decisions.choice: passed over by number: went forward one by one and were counted
decisions.reason: "Passing by" and being counted is used of a flock passing under the shepherd's hand (Jeremiah 33:13). Each side matched the other man for man.

decisions.choice: for Benjamin: Saul's own tribe, the heart of Ish-bosheth's support
decisions.reason: Saul was from Benjamin (1 Samuel 9:1-2), and the Benjaminites rally to Abner in verse 25.

decisions.choice: stepped forward ... They were counted as they came.
decisions.reason: Readable gives the counting its own sentence and says "David's soldiers" as in verse 12.

source.text: וַֽיַּחֲזִ֜קוּ אִ֣ישׁ׀בְּרֹ֣אשׁ רֵעֵ֗הוּ וְחַרְבּוֹ֙ בְּצַ֣ד רֵעֵ֔הוּ וַֽיִּפְּל֖וּ יַחְדָּ֑ו וַיִּקְרָא֙ לַמָּק֣וֹם הַה֔וּא חֶלְקַ֥ת הַצֻּרִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר בְּגִבְעֽוֹן׃

records.literal_gloss: And they seized each by [the] head of his fellow, and his sword in [the] side of his fellow, and they fell together. And one called that place Helkath-hazzurim, which [is] in Gibeon.

en.L: And they seized each one his fellow by the head, and his sword [was] in his fellow's side, and they fell together. And one called that place Helkath-hazzurim, which [is] in Gibeon.
en.B: Each man caught his opponent by the head and thrust his sword into his side, and they fell down together. So that place in Gibeon was named Helkath-hazzurim.
en.R: Each man grabbed the man in front of him by the head and stabbed him in the side with his sword, and they all fell dead together. So that place in Gibeon was named Helkath-hazzurim, which means Field of Sharp Edges.

es.L: Y agarró cada uno a su compañero por la cabeza, y su espada [estaba] en el costado de su compañero, y cayeron juntos. Y se llamó aquel lugar Helcat-hazurim, que [está] en Gabaón.
es.B: Cada uno agarró a su adversario por la cabeza y le clavó la espada en el costado, y cayeron juntos. Por eso aquel lugar de Gabaón se llamó Helcat-hazurim.
es.R: Cada uno agarró por la cabeza al hombre que tenía enfrente y le clavó la espada en el costado, y todos cayeron muertos a la vez. Por eso aquel lugar de Gabaón se llamó Helcat-hazurim, que significa «Campo de los Filos».

fr.L: Et ils saisirent chacun son compagnon par la tête, et son épée [était] dans le flanc de son compagnon, et ils tombèrent ensemble. Et on appela ce lieu Helqath-Hatsourim, qui [est] à Gabaon.
fr.B: Chacun saisit son adversaire par la tête et lui planta son épée dans le flanc, et ils tombèrent tous ensemble. On donna donc à cet endroit de Gabaon le nom de Helqath-Hatsourim.
fr.R: Chaque homme a attrapé par la tête celui qui était en face de lui et lui a enfoncé son épée dans le côté, et ils sont tous tombés morts ensemble. C’est pourquoi on a appelé cet endroit de Gabaon Helqath-Hatsourim, ce qui veut dire « Champ des Lames ».

sw.L: Wakakamata kila mmoja mwenzake kichwani, na upanga wake [ukawa] ubavuni mwa mwenzake, wakaanguka pamoja. Mahali pale pakaitwa Helkath-hazurimu, [palipo] katika Gibeoni.
sw.B: Kila mtu alimkamata mpinzani wake kichwani, akamchoma upanga ubavuni, nao wakaanguka pamoja. Kwa hiyo mahali pale katika Gibeoni pakaitwa Helkath-hazurimu.
sw.R: Kila mtu alimkamata yule aliyekuwa mbele yake kichwani akamchoma upanga ubavuni, nao wote wakaanguka wamekufa pamoja. Kwa hiyo mahali pale katika Gibeoni pakaitwa Helkath-hazurimu, maana yake Shamba la Makali.

vi.L: Mỗi người nắm đầu đối thủ mình, và gươm mình [đâm] vào hông đối thủ, rồi họ cùng ngã xuống. Người ta gọi chỗ ấy là Hên-cát Hát-xu-rim, [nằm] tại Ga-ba-ôn.
vi.B: Mỗi người nắm lấy đầu đối thủ và đâm gươm vào hông người ấy, rồi cả hai cùng ngã xuống. Vì vậy chỗ ấy ở Ga-ba-ôn được gọi là Hên-cát Hát-xu-rim.
vi.R: Mỗi người túm lấy đầu người đối diện và đâm gươm vào hông người ấy, và tất cả cùng ngã chết. Vì vậy chỗ ấy ở Ga-ba-ôn được gọi là Hên-cát Hát-xu-rim, nghĩa là Cánh Đồng Lưỡi Sắc.

ko.L: 그리고 그들이 저마다 자기 상대의 머리를 붙잡고, 자기 칼을 상대의 옆구리에 [찔러], 그들이 함께 쓰러졌다. 그래서 사람들이 그곳을 헬갓핫수림이라고 불렀는데, 기브온에 [있다].
ko.B: 그들은 저마다 상대의 머리를 붙잡고 칼로 상대의 옆구리를 찔러, 모두 함께 쓰러졌다. 그래서 기브온에 있는 그곳을 헬갓핫수림이라고 불렀다.
ko.R: 그들은 저마다 맞은편 사람의 머리를 붙잡고 칼로 옆구리를 찔렀다. 그래서 모두 함께 쓰러져 죽었다. 그래서 기브온에 있는 그곳을 '날카로운 칼날의 밭'이라는 뜻으로 헬갓핫수림이라고 불렀다.

pt.L: E cada um agarrou o seu companheiro pela cabeça, e a sua espada [estava] no lado do seu companheiro, e caíram juntos. E chamaram àquele lugar Helcate-Hazurim, que [está] em Gibeom.
pt.B: Cada homem agarrou o adversário pela cabeça e lhe enfiou a espada no lado, e caíram todos juntos. Por isso aquele lugar em Gibeom foi chamado Helcate-Hazurim.
pt.R: Cada homem agarrou pela cabeça o homem que estava na sua frente e o feriu no lado com a espada, e todos caíram mortos ao mesmo tempo. Por isso aquele lugar em Gibeom recebeu o nome de Helcate-Hazurim, que quer dizer Campo dos Gumes.

decisions.choice: Helkath-hazzurim: "field of sharp edges", either flint knives or sword blades
decisions.reason: "Helkath" means a plot of land. "Hazzurim" is the plural of a word for rock or flint, which is also used for the edge of a sword (Psalm 89:44), so the name may mean "Field of Flints" or "Field of Blades"; both point to the killing that gave it its name. The early Greek translation has a different name, "Field of the Plotters", from a Hebrew word that looks almost the same. Another suggestion links it with "side" earlier in the verse. The name is kept as written.

decisions.choice: his sword in his fellow's side: each struck the other at the same moment
decisions.reason: The clause has no verb, a quick picture of all the thrusts at once. All twenty-four fall together, so the contest settles nothing and the full battle follows (verse 17).

decisions.choice: one called: the place came to be called
decisions.reason: The verb has no named subject; it means people gave the place this name.

decisions.choice: which means Field of Sharp Edges
decisions.reason: Readable gives the meaning of the name. "Sharp edges" is chosen because it fits both flint and sword blades (see m1).

decisions.choice: was named
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable use a passive for the Hebrew's unnamed "one".

decisions.choice: « Champ des Lames »
decisions.reason: Readable gives the meaning of the name, as the English "Field of Sharp Edges". French "lames" fits both flint blades and sword blades (m1).

decisions.choice: maana yake Shamba la Makali
decisions.reason: Readable gives the meaning of the name; "makali" (sharp edges) fits both flint and sword blades, as the English Readable chooses.

decisions.choice: "Hên-cát Hát-xu-rim"; R adds "nghĩa là Cánh Đồng Lưỡi Sắc"
decisions.reason: The name is kept at every level; Readable gives its meaning, as the English does, in a wording that leaves open flint knives or sword blades (meaning decision).

decisions.choice: Helcate-Hazurim (L, B, R); Campo dos Gumes (R)
decisions.reason: The name in the usual Brazilian spelling, with "Helcate" taking the final "-e" Portuguese adds after a consonant. Readable gives its meaning with "gume", the cutting edge of a blade, which, like the English "sharp edges", fits both flint and sword (m1).

source.text: וַתְּהִ֧י הַמִּלְחָמָ֛ה קָשָׁ֥ה עַד־מְאֹ֖ד בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֑וּא וַיִּנָּ֤גֶף אַבְנֵר֙ וְאַנְשֵׁ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לִפְנֵ֖י עַבְדֵ֥י דָוִֽד׃

records.literal_gloss: And was the battle severe up to muchness on the day the that, and was defeated Abner and [the] men of Israel before [the] servants of David.

en.L: And the battle was very severe on that day, and Abner and the men of Israel were defeated before the servants of David.
en.B: A very hard battle followed that day, and David's men defeated Abner and the men of Israel.
en.R: Then a fierce battle broke out that day. David's soldiers beat Abner and the men of Israel.

es.L: Y fue la batalla muy dura aquel día, y fueron derrotados Abner y los hombres de Israel delante de los siervos de David.
es.B: Aquel día se libró una batalla muy dura, y los hombres de David derrotaron a Abner y a los hombres de Israel.
es.R: Entonces estalló una batalla feroz aquel día. Los soldados de David vencieron a Abner y a los hombres de Israel.

fr.L: Et la bataille fut très dure ce jour-là, et Abner et les hommes d’Israël furent battus devant les serviteurs de David.
fr.B: Un combat très dur s’engagea ce jour-là, et les hommes de David battirent Abner et les hommes d’Israël.
fr.R: Alors une bataille terrible a éclaté ce jour-là. Les soldats de David ont battu Abner et les hommes d’Israël.

sw.L: Vita vikawa vikali mno siku ile, naye Abneri na watu wa Israeli wakashindwa mbele ya watumishi wa Daudi.
sw.B: Vita vikali sana vilifuata siku ile, na watu wa Daudi wakamshinda Abneri na watu wa Israeli.
sw.R: Kisha vita vikali vikaanza siku ile. Askari wa Daudi wakamshinda Abneri na watu wa Israeli.

vi.L: Trận chiến hôm ấy rất dữ dội, và Áp-ne cùng người Y-sơ-ra-ên bị đánh bại trước mặt các đầy tớ của Đa-vít.
vi.B: Hôm ấy trận chiến diễn ra rất ác liệt, và quân của Đa-vít đánh bại Áp-ne cùng người Y-sơ-ra-ên.
vi.R: Rồi một trận đánh dữ dội nổ ra hôm ấy. Quân của Đa-vít đánh thắng Áp-ne và người Y-sơ-ra-ên.

ko.L: 그리고 그날 싸움이 매우 치열했고, 아브넬과 이스라엘 사람들이 다윗의 신하들 앞에서 졌다.
ko.B: 그날 매우 치열한 싸움이 벌어졌고, 다윗의 부하들이 아브넬과 이스라엘 사람들을 쳐부수었다.
ko.R: 그러자 그날 큰 싸움이 벌어졌다. 다윗의 군인들이 아브넬과 이스라엘 사람들을 이겼다.

pt.L: E a batalha foi muito dura naquele dia, e Abner e os homens de Israel foram derrotados diante dos servos de Davi.
pt.B: Seguiu-se naquele dia uma batalha muito dura, e os homens de Davi derrotaram Abner e os homens de Israel.
pt.R: Então começou uma batalha violenta naquele dia. Os soldados de Davi venceram Abner e os homens de Israel.

decisions.choice: the battle: the contest turned into a full battle
decisions.reason: The deaths of all twenty-four champions (verse 16) brought both armies into the fight.

decisions.choice: the men of Israel: the forces of the northern tribes under Ish-bosheth
decisions.reason: In this chapter "Israel" is the kingdom of Ish-bosheth, set against Judah (verses 9-10).

decisions.choice: David's men defeated Abner
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable turn "was defeated before" into an active sentence with the same meaning.

source.text: וַיִּֽהְיוּ־שָׁ֗ם שְׁלֹשָׁה֙ בְּנֵ֣י צְרוּיָ֔ה יוֹאָ֥ב וַאֲבִישַׁ֖י וַעֲשָׂהאֵ֑ל וַעֲשָׂהאֵל֙ קַ֣ל בְּרַגְלָ֔יו כְּאַחַ֥ד הַצְּבָיִ֖ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר בַּשָּׂדֶֽה׃
